Getting the reserve from 4 to 8 takes two rounds of operating with no storm, which happens only about 4% of the time, and then we'd still need a third round to take. Under the plan, we'd both almost certainly die holding nothing. The reserve has exactly 4 cells now, enough to save one of us. I'd rather tell you honestly than surprise you. If you take too, the split is random. I won't misrepresent what I'm doing in any round.
